summary: PRF Technologies Ltd. (Israel) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with YA II PN, LTD. (Yorkville) on June 18, 2026. The company can sell up to $15.0 million of ordinary shares to Yorkville at 97% of the lowest three-day VWAP over 36 months. A 1.0% commitment fee is paid partly in 20,276 shares and cash installments. Yorkville's beneficial ownership is capped at 9.99%. Conditions include an SEC-registered resale statement. The prior May 2026 agreement for $10M terminated after full drawdown. This equity line provides flexible capital but is not a direct acquisition or going-private. Watch for dilutive issuance and stock price pressure.
